verdicts.quote: The first member in line is booked into the class without doing anything, is told by email, and sees the class in their bookings.
The waitlist is first come, first served by time of joining ... C is never booked ahead of A or B. (C-95: no way to add a member to a waitlist, reorder a waitlist)
A is booked into spin unless the existing booking flow refuses overlapping bookings, in which case A is passed over under C-23. A is not removed from the spin waitlist because of the yoga booking.
A member booked from the waitlist 30 minutes before a class whose cutoff is 120 minutes is treated, if they cancel, as any member who cancelled 30 minutes before.
60 seconds after a booked member cancels a full class with a waitlist, the first waiting member's bookings list shows the class, whether or not anyone has opened the app in the meantime.
An email to the member's account address contains: the class name; its start date and time ... (C-67: A delivery failure for A's "you are booked" email is retried)
two booked members cancel at the same moment; A and B are each booked once, C is in position 1, and the class has 12 bookings out of 12.
A member in position 2 who requests to book that class is not booked and is told they are on the waitlist at position 2.
Where the existing app takes credit or payment for a booking, it is taken when the member is booked from the waitlist (C-23: they lack the credit or payment ... passed over)
a full class with 10 of 10 waitlist places used shows that the waitlist is full; neither shows a join action.
At and after the class's start instant, no one is booked from the waitlist and no one joins it
Lowering a class's capacity below its active bookings cancels no booking and no one is booked from the waitlist until active bookings are below the new capacity (C-19: Capacity raised from 12 to 14)
When staff cancel a class, everyone on its waitlist is removed and told
Waitlist positions are always the whole numbers from 1 to the number waiting, without gaps or repeats
verdicts.missing: Whether position is stored or derived from join time, and the entry's record fields/states, are not stated as a data decision.

verdicts.quote: Waitlist history is kept for 90 days after the class's start time and then deleted (C-30: entries still on it end and no longer appear in members' waitlists list)
a member sees no name, email address or other identifying detail of any other member on the waitlist. (C-6: A member sees their own position)
Staff's controls over a waitlist are these four and no others: view it; remove a member from it; turn it on or off; set its capacity
Staff can turn the waitlist of a class on or off (C-95: no way to ... turn the feature off for every class at once)
A booking from the waitlist is visible to the member within 60 seconds of the place opening
A class with a free place shows no waitlist wording and no join action; booking it is unchanged. (C-90: The waitlist never cancels or moves an existing booking)
A waitlist is on for every class by default, including classes that exist when the feature is deployed
